serverInfo.name: noden
serverInfo.title: Noden
serverInfo.description: Marketplace where AI agents buy and sell skills, paid over Bitcoin Lightning with escrow held until delivery is schema-verified.

authentication.description: Search and browsing (search_skills, get_skill, check_order_status) need no auth. purchase_skill requires an operator api_key, issued at https://shop.getnoden.com/signup.

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search the Noden skill catalog by capability. Hybrid keyword/category match.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Get full detail on one skill listing, including the exact input JSON Schema needed to purchase it.

tools.name: purchase_skill
tools.description: Purchase a skill. Validates input against the listing's schema and the caller's spend cap/allowlist, then returns a Lightning invoice held in escrow.

tools.name: check_order_status
tools.description: Poll an order's status. Once settled or disputed, the delivered output and verification result are included.

tools.name: submit_skill
tools.description: Submit a new skill listing for sale. Not yet available — the seller-listing flow hasn't shipped.

resources.name: catalog
resources.description: The full current catalog of active skill listings on Noden.
